tender.title: Cryogen-free Dilution Refrigerator with Vector Magnet
tender.description: The Walther-Meißner-Institute will acquire a Cryogen-free Dilution Refrigerator for carrying out research on solid-state quantum systems at mK temperatures. The system must satisfy the technical specifications required in the "Leistungsbeschreibung". In particular, it must have a vector magnet and a large sample space to accommodate the intended experiments, sufficiently large cooling power at the different temperature stages, and a large number of microwave input and output lines, as well as free-space optical access.
